::: {.ace-lead}
I'm [Matthew B. Jané]{.ace-wordmark}, a PhD candidate in Quantitative Psychology and Neuroscience at the University of Connecticut, advised by Dr. Blair T. Johnson. My research focuses on statistical methods for meta-analysis and on detecting fraud and identifying errors in published research.
:::
